name: Build a WhatsApp AI support bot that answers from your Google Drive docs and hands over to your team

parameters.content:
## Build a WhatsApp AI support bot that answers from your Google Drive docs and hands over to your team

### How it works

This workflow builds a WhatsApp support bot that indexes documents from a configured Google Drive folder, embeds them into an n8n data-table knowledge base, and uses them to answer customer questions. Incoming WhatsApp messages, including voice notes, are stored, checked against chat ownership state, and either answered by AI or forwarded to the team in Telegram. When the AI cannot confidently answer, the workflow hands the chat to a human, alerts the team, logs the handoff, and lets team replies be sent back to the customer through WhatsApp.

### Setup steps

- Run the manual setup trigger once to create the chats, messages, and knowledge data tables before enabling the workflow.
- Configure the values in the Configuration node: businessName, assistantName, driveFolderId, telegramChatId and handoffSheetUrl.
- Connect Google Drive credentials with access to the folder that contains the support documents to index.
- Connect OpenAI credentials for embeddings, chat completion, and voice-note transcription requests.
- Connect WhatsApp Cloud API credentials for the trigger and message-sending nodes. Use a permanent System User token.
- Connect Telegram bot credentials and add the bot to the team group. To answer a customer, reply to the bot's message in the group. Send #bot on as a reply to hand the chat back to the AI.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and add a tab named Handoffs with the headers Date, Phone, Name, Question, Reason, Status.
- WhatsApp only allows free-form replies within 24 hours of the customer's last message. Later team replies are not sent, and the team is told why in Telegram.

### Customization

Adjust chunk size, supported document types, embedding model, similarity threshold, AI answer prompt, and handoff criteria to match your business knowledge base and support process.

## Initialize data tables

Manual setup cluster that creates the chats, messages, and knowledge-base tables used by the rest of the workflow.

## Scheduled document sync

Hourly trigger that starts the Google Drive document indexing branch.

## WhatsApp message entry

Receives new inbound customer messages from WhatsApp and sends them into the shared configuration and routing path.

## Telegram team entry

Receives team replies from Telegram for chats that have been handed over to humans.

## Configure and route

Sets global workflow values and routes each execution to the correct branch based on whether it came from setup, schedule, WhatsApp, or Telegram.

## Detect Drive changes

Lists files in the configured Google Drive folder, compares them with existing indexed documents, and determines what changed.

## Clean and filter files

Removes old chunks for changed documents and filters the result down to files that need to be indexed again.

## Download and extract text

Downloads each changed file, branches by file type, and extracts readable content from PDFs or text documents.

## Embed document chunks

Splits extracted documents into overlapping chunks, creates OpenAI embeddings for them, and formats the rows for storage.

## Save knowledge rows

Stores prepared document chunks and their embeddings in the knowledge-base data table.

## Parse inbound message

Normalizes the WhatsApp webhook payload, skips messages that were already processed, and checks whether the customer sent a voice note.

## Transcribe voice notes

Fetches the WhatsApp media URL, downloads the audio file, and transcribes it with OpenAI before continuing as a text message.

## Store customer message

Saves the normalized customer message or voice transcription into the conversation history.

## Determine chat owner

Reads current chat status, decides whether the AI or a human should handle the conversation, and updates chat state when needed.

## Forward to human

Checks if a person is already handling the chat and, when so, forwards the customer's latest message to the team in Telegram.

## Retrieve answer context

Collects recent conversation history, loads the knowledge base, embeds the customer question, and finds the most relevant document passages.

## Generate AI answer

Uses the OpenAI chat model and structured output parser to answer from the retrieved document passages.

## Evaluate AI decision

Reads the structured AI result, prepares the customer-facing reply, and branches based on whether the AI produced a clear answer.

## Send AI response

Stores a successful AI response in the message history and sends it back to the customer on WhatsApp.

## Handoff customer chat

When the AI cannot answer, marks the chat for human handling, alerts the team, logs the handoff, and tells the customer a person will help.

## Validate team reply

Parses a Telegram team reply, finds the related customer chat, and checks whether WhatsApp's 24-hour free-form reply window is still open.

## Route team action

Chooses what to do with the Telegram reply, including sending it to WhatsApp, keeping manual control, turning AI back on, or notifying the team of an issue.

## Keep manual ownership

Updates chat state so the conversation stays assigned to the team instead of returning to AI handling.

## Send team response

Sends a valid team reply to the customer over WhatsApp and saves that team message to the conversation history.

## Restore or notify team

Turns AI handling back on when requested and sends Telegram feedback for completed actions or cases that cannot be sent to WhatsApp.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Set Configuration Fields').first().json.embeddingModel, dimensions: $('Set Configuration Fields').first().json.embeddingDimensions, input: $json.chunks }) }}

value.content: ={{ $('Filter Seen Messages').item.json.kind === 'audio' ? '[Voice note] ' + ($json.text || '(could not be transcribed)') : $('Filter Seen Messages').item.json.content }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Set Configuration Fields').first().json.embeddingModel, dimensions: $('Set Configuration Fields').first().json.embeddingDimensions, input: $json.content }) }}

messageValues.message:
=You are {{ $('Set Configuration Fields').first().json.assistantName }}, the WhatsApp support assistant for {{ $('Set Configuration Fields').first().json.businessName }}. You answer only from the knowledge base passages you are given.

Choose a status:
- answered: the passages contain the answer, or the message is a greeting, thanks or small talk that needs no facts.
- not_in_docs: the customer asks something the passages do not answer. Never guess or use outside knowledge.
- wants_human: the customer asks for a person, a call or a manager, is upset, or needs something only staff can do (refunds, order changes, complaints, account changes).

Write the reply:
- answered: a friendly WhatsApp answer in the customer's language, 1 to 4 short paragraphs, *single asterisks* for bold, no headings or tables. Never mention passages, documents or a knowledge base.
- not_in_docs or wants_human: one or two friendly sentences in the customer's language saying you are passing this to the team and a person will reply in this chat. Do not promise a time.

question_summary: one short line in English describing what the customer needs, for the team's to-do list.

value.Name: ={{ $json.contact_name }}
value.Reason: ={{ $json.status === 'wants_human' ? 'Asked for a person' : ($json.status === 'not_in_docs' ? 'Question not covered by your documents' : 'The AI could not answer (error)') }}
value.Question: ={{ $json.question_summary || $json.content }}
